initial_skin.method: deformed weighted triangle regions + capped-region ray-parity containment; local connected-joint seam exemptions
limitations: Automated triage, not human visual approval.
Within one anatomical region is not tested against itself, including finger-to-finger/palm collisions within the same hand.
Connected-joint seams have small local exemptions.
Cut capping can overapproximate concave regions; flagged contacts require inspection.
